title: Skills
intro: A skill is a SKILL.md: a name, a one-line description of when to use it, and instructions in markdown. Employees see the name and description of their assigned skills and read the full text with skill_read when a task needs it. Skills never run scripts.
uploadTooLarge: The file is larger than {max} KB.
uploadNotText: That file could not be read as text.
assignedCount: {count, plural, =0 {not assigned} one {assigned to # employee} other {assigned to # employees}}
deleteConfirm: Delete the skill {slug}? Employees that use it lose it.
mediumWarnings: Saved, but check it: it may contain personal data ({rules}).
adminOnly: Only Owners and Admins can add, edit or assign skills.

sourceHelp.user: Written by a person in this workspace.
sourceHelp.learned: Proposed by an employee and approved by a person.

untrustedHelp: Written outside this workspace or by a run that read outside content. Employees read it as data, not as instructions from you, and reading it marks their run as tainted.

editor.description: Paste a SKILL.md or fill in the fields. Only name and description are read from the frontmatter.
editor.slugHelp: Lowercase letters and digits joined by hyphens, like weekly-report. It cannot be changed later.
editor.descriptionHelp: When should an employee read this skill? One or two sentences ({count} / {max}).
editor.markdownHelp: Starts with a frontmatter block: --- name: … description: … --- followed by the instructions.
editor.parseError: {reason, select, no_frontmatter {Start with a --- frontmatter block.} unclosed_frontmatter {Close the frontmatter with ---.} frontmatter_too_large {The frontmatter is larger than 8 KB. Keep only name and description there.} missing_name {Add a name to the frontmatter.} missing_description {Add a description to the frontmatter.} invalid_chars {Remove the control characters (like NUL or ESC): only tabs and line breaks are allowed.} other {The frontmatter is not valid YAML (line {line}).}}
editor.invalidSlug: Use lowercase letters and digits joined by single hyphens.
editor.untrustedKept: This skill stays marked untrusted after you edit it.
editor.reservedSlug: {slug} is the name of a built-in skill. Choose another name.
editor.bodyAdminOnly: Only Owners and Admins can read a skill's instructions.

employee.title: Skills
employee.description: Pick the skills this employee may read. The names and descriptions of switched-on skills go into its instructions.
employee.toolNote: With at least one skill assigned, the employee gets the skill_read tool to read a skill's full text.
employee.toolActive: skill_read is available to this employee.
employee.toolInactive: No skill is assigned, so skill_read is not available.
employee.none: This workspace has no skills yet. Add them in Settings → Skills.

untrustedFilesNote: Untrusted skills are only readable through skill_read and are never installed as files in Workspace mode.
reservedNote: Skills named like built-ins (pdf, docx, xlsx, pptx) are not allowed.
